narrative: Escalating geopolitical friction in the Strait of Hormuz dominates weekend headlines, setting up a risk-off crude bid for the Tokyo open as Iran asserts authority over vessel traffic against U.S. territorial claims. This volatility likely supports CAD outperformance (1W avg +1.064%) and is likely to weigh on JPY, which closed Friday at 159.31 and continues to lag G10 peers (1W avg -1.018%). EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1573, facing a +144bp OIS carry disadvantage that is likely to cap upside despite a moderate positive ESI (+5.7). Markets await the FOMC minutes on Wednesday as the next major volatility catalyst.
